caption: The video captures a sunlit alpine ski slope with a chairlift tower on the left, snow-covered peaks behind, and a bright low sun throwing a starburst and lens flare. A lone skier already in motion glides diagonally across the foreground from near the tower base toward the lower-right, growing slightly larger. This skier slips out of the bottom edge partway through, leaving the foreground clear. A second figure appears briefly at the bottom-right corner early on before leaving the frame. Meanwhile the chairlift chairs travel steadily along the cable, the right-hand chair drifting toward the sun while the left-hand chairs also advance along the line. The camera gradually tightens on the tower and backdrop, raising the crossbar and enlarging the orange base pad and chairs, so the marker pole with its red flag and the mountains shift within the frame while remaining present.
relations: As the camera tightens on the tower, the orange base pad and chairs enlarge while the marker pole and mountains shift within frame but persist.
The right-hand chair advances along the cable toward the sun while the left-hand chairs also travel steadily along the line.
The foreground skier glides diagonally from near the tower base toward the lower-right, growing larger before slipping out of the bottom edge.
The second figure at the bottom-right corner appears briefly then leaves the frame, clearing the foreground.
